item.title: Broncos secondary coach Jim Leonhard leaving for Buffalo DC job, source says
item.description: The Broncos are losing yet another coach to a coordinator posting in Buffalo. Secondary coach Jim Leonhard has been hired as the Bills' defensive coordinator.

item.title: Grading The Week: Nuggets’ Nikola Jokic isn’t just back. He’s behind the back, just like old times
item.description: Nikola Jokic averages about 35 minutes per game. Which means if the Joker wasn't on a "pitch count" against the Clippers, he was a pace for 43 points, 16 boards and seven assists. All after a month on the shelf.

item.title: Man killed, baby seriously injured in Aurora hit-and-run crash
item.description: A man was killed and a baby was seriously injured on Friday night after a 19-year-old driver ran a red light, T-boned their car and fled the scene, according to the Aurora Police Department.

item.title: Suspect arrested on suspicion of sexual assault at Aurora park
